876	function sendTrailer (payload, res, reply) {
877	  if (reply[kReplyTrailers] === null) {
878	    // when no trailer, we close the stream
879	    res.end(null, null, null) // avoid ArgumentsAdaptorTrampoline from V8
880	    return
881	  }
882	  const trailerHeaders = Object.keys(reply[kReplyTrailers])
883	  const trailers = {}
884	  let handled = 0
885	  let skipped = true
886	  let sent = false
887	  function send () {
888	    // add trailers when all handler handled
889	    /* istanbul ignore else */
890	    if (handled === 0 && !sent) {
891	      sent = true
892	      res.addTrailers(trailers)
893	      // we need to properly close the stream
894	      // after trailers sent
895	      res.end(null, null, null) // avoid ArgumentsAdaptorTrampoline from V8
896	    }
897	  }
898	
899	  for (const trailerName of trailerHeaders) {
900	    if (typeof reply[kReplyTrailers][trailerName] !== 'function') continue
901	    skipped = false
902	    handled--
903	
904	    let cbAlreadyCalled = false
905	    function cb (err, value) {
906	      if (cbAlreadyCalled) return
907	      cbAlreadyCalled = true
908	      handled++
909	
910	      // we can safely ignore error for trailer
911	      // since it does affect the client
912	      // we log in here only for debug usage
913	      if (err) reply.log.debug(err)
914	      else trailers[trailerName] = value
915	
916	      // we push the check to the end of event
917	      // loop, so the registration continue to
918	      // process.
919	      process.nextTick(send)
920	    }
921	
922	    const result = reply[kReplyTrailers][trailerName](reply, payload, cb)
923	    if (typeof result === 'object' && typeof result.then === 'function') {
924	      result.then((v) => cb(null, v), cb)
925	    }
926	  }
927	
928	  // when all trailers are skipped
929	  // we need to close the stream
930	  if (skipped) res.end(null, null, null) // avoid ArgumentsAdaptorTrampoline from V8
931	}
